screen34-a1.glyph: red and yellow striped flag with a numeral beside it
screen34-a1.description: flag picture with a count beside it, first item of the top bar
screen34-a1.visible_text: none that names the purpose; a Spanish-style flag glyph and the numeral "1"
screen34-a1.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc/talkback "Learning Spanish" — told me to expect a course/language control; not used in the verdict
screen34-a1.convention_relied_on: a national flag in an app's top bar is an established language/region-selector convention — my reading, confidence medium; the numeral beside it is not explained
screen34-a1.initial_rationale: no words, but a flag is a widely used convention for 'language / course' and the context is a language-learning path; common-icon exemption pending the behavioural test
screen34-a1.deciding_evidence: carried from screen1-a1 (same control, same position, on a duplicate capture), tested once there: the flag opened the course panel, which is what the language-flag convention promises

screen34-a2.glyph: grey flame outline with a numeral beside it
screen34-a2.description: flame outline with a count beside it in the top bar
screen34-a2.visible_text: none that names the purpose; flame glyph and the numeral "1"
screen34-a2.accessibility_text_consulted: content_desc "1 day streak" — told me to expect a streak page; not used in the verdict
screen34-a2.convention_relied_on: no established mobile convention: a flame is read as 'hot/trending' or 'fire', not as a daily-practice record — my reading, confidence medium
screen34-a2.initial_rationale: unlabeled glyph that is not a first-time-user convention; the bare numeral does not say what is being counted
screen34-a2.deciding_evidence: carried from screen1-a2 (same control, same position, on a duplicate capture), tested once there: nothing visible names the control before it is tapped; only the page it opens says 'Streak'
screen34-a2.recommendation: add a visible word under the glyph, e.g. 'Streak: 1 day', so the count and the destination are named
